Nothing shipped on this task. The right-column overlap is already gone, and the duplicate alert is two copies by his own order, not three. This is from a previous run's notes and pictures; I didn't take fresh ones this run.

- **Screen 34 (downed, pickups):** on HEAD (v34.31) no two text boxes in the right column touch at 1080p or at 4K. The P2 window wasn't shot, since the layout code is the same for both seats. Nothing to fix.
- **Screen 33 (fight alerts):** the alert is drawn twice, not three times. The red banner or top-centre row is one copy, and the left feed row is the other. This applies to "the pillbox has seen you", "location revealed" and "running slowly". The feed copy comes from his 10-15 order (cw-feedall) that all on-screen text also goes into the player feed. Removing it would reverse that order, so I left it and logged the question as 91 in `questions.md`.
- **Critic scores:** both screens scored 2, so neither reached the target of 4. For 34 the critic's top finding is that the downed card is a flat box, not the standard panel. It also flagged wrapping contract rows in the run info. For 33 it flagged the duplicate alerts and the controls cheat-sheet in the centre of the screen. The cheat-sheet shows on the first raid only and is the F1 list, so I left it.
- **Next real work:** restyling the downed card as the standard panel and fixing the run info wrap. These need their own task.

TASK PARTIAL: both defects checked (overlap already gone, duplicate alert is two copies by his feed-all order, question 91 open), critic scores 2 and 2; downed card as standard panel and run info wrap remain for a new task.

NEXT: no further work on 106; the next task is whatever the queue gives lane c.
